summary: Minnesota Forest Service 81-foot ladder tower at Rail Prairie, Morrison County, built 1930; 1931 fire trapped its lookout; moved to Motley in 1954; site now inside Camp Ripley.

facts.status_note: Moved to the Motley site in Cass County in 1954; a 1956 note says it no longer stood

events.note: 81-foot ladder tower erected at Rail Prairie, south of Pillager; April 1930 newspaper says nearing completion
Scott Mitchell of Pine River placed on duty as towerman, August 1930
John Devine listed as lookout man in the 1931 report
Fire swept the area around the tower; lookout John Devine trapped for three hours; newspaper account (Brainerd Daily Dispatch, quoted by Forest Lookouts) dated May 2, 1931
Moved to the Motley site in Cass County
Survey note: tower no longer stands at Rail Prairie
Phase II testing report on the Rail Prairie Forestry Lookout Tower Site (21MO81), Camp Ripley

notes_for_editor: Build year 1930 and the 1954 move agree across two tower lists. Staffing and the 1931 fire rest on one page that quotes Brainerd Daily Dispatch articles; the articles themselves were not read. Access not checked: the site lies inside Camp Ripley, but no source on public access was read, so no access level is set. The tDAR abstract was not read; the 1995 date comes from the record header. Morrison County list places the Motley move in Cass County; firelookout.org lists Motley as Tower Gone, not checked further.
